method: Fresh Codex qualitative review with two read-only Sol High packages. Same baseline rubric. Final [N] -> final sources[N-1] -> chunk_id -> exact saved tool text for current turn; expansion uses saved citation evidence. Fresh independent per-case review. Runtime gpt-6-luna / Responses medium; prior scores not inherited. Failed requests retained as 0/null. No judge API or repeated retrieval.

rubric.correctness: 1=essential reference complete/correct;0.5=significant omission/minor factual error;0=core wrong or no requested answer
rubric.grounding: 1=all material claims supported by actual cited fragments;0.5=minor unsupported detail/imprecision;0=material unsupported/generalized claim;null=no factual claim or failed request
